newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding names group finance officer.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding names group finance officer.

text.p: CS Holding AG said its board of directors had named Richard Thornburgh, from CS First Boston, as chief financial officer of the Credit Suisse Group as of January 1, 1997.

A company statement said Thornburgh would take over as CFO from Phillip Colebatch, the current chief financial and administrative officer of CS Holding and ad interim CFO for the planned Credit Suisse Group.
CS Holding will change its name to Credit Suisse Group as of January 1 under a reorganisation announced in July to streamline its bank and financial activities in four new divisions.
Colebatch will take an already announced position as head of the newly formed Credit Suisse Asset Management division.
Thornburgh is chief financial and administrative officer at CS First Boston and an executive board member at CS First Boston.
"The work begun at the start of July this year to create a new, market and customer-oriented group structure is proceeding on schedule," the statement said.
It also said the CS board of directors and directors of bank flagship bank Credit Suisse had settled on names for the four new divisions, based on customer surveys.
Swiss domestic banking will be named Credit Suisse. Private banking will be done by Credit Suisse Private Banking.
Institutional asset management will be under the unit Credit Suisse Asset Management.
Finally, Credit Suisse First Boston will be the name for activities in corporate and investment banking.
